statements.A:
WITH context_rows AS (
  SELECT 'CVIS' AS series_id, hour_start, price_php_mwh,
         n_resources_out_hour, CAST(0 AS FLOAT64) AS assumed_available_capacity_mw
  FROM `synthetic-project.whatif.price_hourly_fixture`
  WHERE hour_start > TIMESTAMP_SUB(TIMESTAMP '2026-10-02T23:00:00', INTERVAL 64 HOUR)
    AND hour_start <= TIMESTAMP '2026-10-02T23:00:00'
), future_rows AS (
  SELECT 'CVIS' AS series_id, hour_start, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT64) AS price_php_mwh,
         CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS n_resources_out_hour,
         CAST(100 AS FLOAT64) AS assumed_available_capacity_mw
  FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_TIMESTAMP_ARRAY(TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '2026-10-02T23:00:00', INTERVAL 1 HOUR),
        TIMESTAMP_ADD(TIMESTAMP '2026-10-02T23:00:00', INTERVAL 48 HOUR), INTERVAL 1 HOUR)) AS hour_start
), model_input AS (
  SELECT * FROM context_rows UNION ALL SELECT * FROM future_rows
)
SELECT *
FROM AI.FORECAST((SELECT * FROM model_input),
  target_cols => ['price_php_mwh'], timestamp_col => 'hour_start', id_cols => ['series_id'],
  model => 'TimesFM 3.0', horizon => 48, context_window => 64, confidence_level => 0.95,
  past_covariate_cols => ['n_resources_out_hour'],
  future_covariate_cols => ['assumed_available_capacity_mw']);
